critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.jsx is 2132 lines — exceeds the 700 LOC guideline; consider splitting adaptOrder/adaptTable/adaptWalkIn/enrichTable helpers into a separate module.

aggregatorTransform.js customer field uses restaurant_order_id split which produces '#002359' — acceptable for the frozen design but consider using customerName ('Vansh') as the primary display and order# as a secondary label to reduce mystery-meat labels.
TableCard.jsx source badge relies on lowercase source==='zomato' check; if backend returns 'Zomato' with capital Z the badge falls back to Swiggy orange. Consider .toLowerCase() normalization.

AggregatorDispatchModal header still says 'Dispatch Order' — if design mockup requires 'Dispatch Aggregator Order' as parallel to reject modal, header should be updated (currently only button label was fixed).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing preprod aggregator orders 40474-40477 (Swiggy).
context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-106 fully verified. If further aggregator work is needed: agg-ready-btn onClick handler fires onAggregatorReady callback in DashboardPage — verify that callback opens the correct confirmation modal / calls the acceptOrder API. Ready button click was clicked during test but no visible modal appeared — this may be intentional (fire-and-forget PATCH) or may need visual feedback (toast). Worth confirming with product intent.
rca of the issue: Root cause was 3-fold: (1) aggregatorTransform missing tableStatus + customer fields → cards rendered as 'Available' empty slots; (2) DashboardPage.adaptOrder didn't propagate isAggregator/source → S/Z branch in TableCard never triggered; (3) TableCard had no S/Z badge rendering block. All three fixed and verified in DOM.
